import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    st = np.sqrt(t)
    c = np.cos(params[9]*st)
    s = np.sin(params[9]*st)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]*x**3 + params[3]*np.log(x) + params[4]/v
            + (params[5] + params[6]*st)*c + (params[7] + params[8]*st)*s)
